items.label: Voice-matched outreach
items.title: Cold outreach and follow-ups, drafted in your own voice -
items.title_emphasis: I use it to book these calls.
items.description: Same style-learning engine as the content pipeline's voice engine, just pointed at outreach instead of posts. It drafts the first-touch emails and the follow-ups, and they actually sound like you wrote them, not some copy-paste template. Built it for a client first. Now it runs my own pipeline's prospecting, this site included.

items.label: Content pipeline
items.title: Cut a 6-hour weekly content task to
items.description: One event kicks off the whole chain. Update emails and feedback requests go straight out, and the system drafts the LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Facebook posts itself, in that person's own voice, learned from a sample of what they've actually written before. Not a template. A stats page tracks how it's actually landing. The only thing a human still does is hit approve.

items.label: Zossima
items.title: One coach that adapts to
items.title_emphasis: how you like to be pushed.
items.description: One coach that covers fitness, headspace and journaling, and it actually learns your tone across all of it: more direct here, gentler there, depending on what's actually landing for you. Journaling is what closes the loop. Flag a pattern once, say late-night Instagram scrolling your ex's page leaves you feeling like crap, it can just lock that app past a set time. No extra app, no extra step. It also runs a lightweight contact list: flag the people you actually mean to keep in touch with, and it nudges you when it's been too long. A weekly check-in stacks what you planned against what you actually did, without turning it into some scorecard. Built on a Psychology background (BSc, University of Sussex) - the tone-adaptation isn't a prompt trick, it's designed around how people actually respond to feedback.
flow: Learns your style across all of it
